item.title: About Me
item.description:
I began programming in 2019, just before the COVID-19 pandemic. When lockdowns started in 2020, while many turned to games and entertainment, I found myself drawn to a documentary about Artificial Intelligence — and that moment changed everything. What started as simple curiosity quickly became a lifelong passion.

Since then, I have explored multiple programming languages, including Python, C, C++, and Rust, building a strong foundation in software development. However, what truly excites me is the intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Mathematics — understanding not just how algorithms work, but why they work.

item.title: Why AI Captured My Curiosity — And Why It Should Capture Yours Too
item.description:
It all started in 2019, just before the world went into lockdown. While friends were playing games or scrolling endlessly through social media, I stumbled upon a documentary about Artificial Intelligence. That one hour changed everything. Suddenly, I realized that AI wasn’t just a buzzword — it was a doorway into a world where mathematics, logic, and creativity collide.

My Journey

From that moment, curiosity turned into passion. I started exploring programming with Python, C, and C++, later experimenting with Rust. Each language taught me something new, but what truly fascinated me was the why behind AI — the mathematics, the algorithms, and the reasoning that makes machines intelligent.
